title: Concept: Cookie written from script
description: An assignment to document.cookie in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: A cookie set from script cannot carry HttpOnly, so the same script context that writes it can also read it, and any injected script inherits that access.
applicability: Single-page apps, consent banners and session-refresh logic.
risk: Cookies without HttpOnly are readable by any script on the origin, which turns one XSS into session theft.
